title: Crystal Lake
headline: “Best 5 minutes of my life!” - NYCC Guest
intro: IHC CRAFTED AN IMMERSIVE HORROR EXPERIENCE AT NYCC FOR PEACOCK'S HIT TV SHOW CRYSTAL LAKE.

introPieces.html:
IHC transformed a central footprint at New York Comic Con into a fully immersive recreation of Camp Crystal Lake - a weathered cabin exterior giving way to richly detailed forest and shed interiors, brought to life by live theatrical performances and capped by a climactic scare moment inside Jason’s shed.

The result: a dual-purpose activation that doubled as a fully realized guest experience and a strategic content engine, giving press and creators a dedicated environment to capture the talent walkthrough and the experience’s signature scare moment alike. A virtual queue let fans reserve a spot, driving 15k+ sign-ups across the four-day run and sending hundreds of groups through the full experience.

pieces.html: A cabin facade jutted out from the walls to immerse guests into the world. A custom sign hung from a post at the line entrance, and a camp bulletin board had in-world easter eggs that guests could browse while they listened to excerpts from Radio Crystal Lake. The facade was covered in 360 key art, serving as a large scale photo moment.

The interior of the cabin was full of era-accurate decor, camp bunk beds, trunks, lamps, and Jason’s hidden camp sack. Our forest area was filled with foliage, eerie lighting, and a practical shed facade. The interior of Jason's shed was dimly lit with a dead hippie immediately discoverable on entrance as well as knick knacks left behind including lanterns, Chuckles candy bars, and a toy laser gun.

Guests queued through an immersive pre-show before Barry and Claudette welcomed them as the camp’s newest counselors and brought them inside for orientation. Orientation broke down when a panicked hippie burst in searching for her missing friend, pulling Barry away to chase down a prop thief and leaving Claudette alone with Pam Voorhees.

Pam uncovered Jason’s machete mid-rant, and a scream outside sent Claudette running back in to report a body in the woods - then Pam snapped, launching the central scare and sending guests fleeing toward Jason’s shed. Fleeing through the woods, the group found a frightened Barry and the hippies’ body among the trees as they reached the entrance to Jason’s shed.

Inside, the lights cut out and Pam reappeared for one final scare (triggering our “scream” photo opp) before Sheriff Brooks arrived and she vanished. On the way out, a BA handed guests a custom Crystal Lake bandana, and guests could complete a consumer insights survey for an exclusive “Pam’s Bloody Sweater” pin.
